comment: Game-data record layouts the reader needs that have moved between patches. Hex strings are byte offsets. Steam build 26636972.

dropSet.comment: One byte added before the count (0x11 -> 0x12) and one before each entry's trailing item (0x3C -> 0x3D); entries grew 0x40 -> 0x41. Checked on 1015077 (1 item), 1015078 (2) and 1015082 (3): amounts equal the record comments.

skillSlots.comment: Slot runs now 1,581-1,585 bytes apart (were ~1,504) and the skill key sits 768 bytes before the marker (was 696). Brant, Matilda and Luke decode to the same slots as on 2.04.08.
